referents.why: First common singular 'me' in the psalm's own voice. The psalm does not quote anyone else here, so 'me' is the psalmist (voice candidate).
referents.category: first person in psalm's own voice

referents.why: Same first common singular 'me' as w4, in the second line, in the psalm's own voice.
referents.category: first person in psalm's own voice

referents.why: Third masculine singular implied subject of 'makes me lie down'. LORD and David both agree in morphology, but the act is a shepherd's act, and verse 1 gives the shepherd's role to the LORD ('The LORD is my shepherd'). David appears only in the heading and does not act in this psalm.
referents.category: implied subject carried from the preceding verse

referents.why: Third masculine singular implied subject of 'leads me'. It is the same shepherd act as the first line, so it has the same referent, the LORD of verse 1.
referents.category: implied subject carried from the preceding verse

groups.why: Two asyndetic lines with no conjunction between them. The second repeats the first's he-acts-on-me pattern with the same implied subject, the LORD. The parallelism is carried by the group kind, not by a link.
groups.category: parallel lines with a shared implied subject
